definitions.explanation: Something that serves no purpose or achieves nothing.
As a noun, something that is wasted or unnecessary.

examples.japanese: {時間|じかん}を{無駄|むだ}にしないで。
それは{無駄|むだ}だと{思|おも}う。
{無駄|むだ}な{努力|どりょく}だった。

notes:
Functions as a na-adjective and noun.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{無駄|むだ}な + noun ({無駄|むだ}な{時間|じかん} = wasted time)
・{無駄|むだ}にする (to waste)
・{無駄|むだ}になる (to be wasted)
・{無駄|むだ}{遣|づか}い (wasteful spending)
・{無駄|むだ}{話|ばなし} (idle chatter)

{無駄|むだ}にする is commonly used with time, money, or effort.
